units.summary: Adds a test helper that returns the source argument of every mocked cp call with backslashes normalized to slashes. It only supports the new assertions about which guide files get copied, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
units.headline: Test helper lists normalized sources of mocked cp calls
units.reason: New test-only helper that cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: Updates expectations and adds tests for the split agentic upgrade guides (shared, same-major, different-major, future-defaults): guide paths, which docs are copied, and the new prompt text. Some old assertions were replaced, including the codemod-command check in the canary test and the recursive upgrading-directory copy check, so the expectations now match new behavior.
units.headline: Tests updated for split per-policy agentic upgrade guides
units.reason: Existing expectations and snapshots were changed to match new behavior and an assertion was removed, which could hide a regression.
risk_signals: expectations changed to match new behavior
focus: Canary handoff test no longer asserts the codemod command ('upgrade 17.2.0-canary.9 --yes --skip-adoption'); confirm a cross-major canary path is still covered
Inline snapshots of the new prompt text match what next-upgrade.ts intends, including the shared.md-first instruction
Negative assertions on future-defaults.md and /02-pages/ rely on normalized cp sources and cover the intended cases
